references.text: Parallel text describing the same measurements for the east side of the courtyard facing the sunrise, fifty cubits wide, in the instructions given to Moses.
Part of the broader context where Bezalel and Oholiab carry out the work on the tabernacle in accordance with the Lord's command.
Moses, Aaron, and his sons camped in front of the tabernacle, toward the east, facing the sunrise, guarding the sanctuary.
Ezekiel's vision of the temple where the glory of the Lord comes from the east, linking the eastern side to God's presence and entrance.
Water flows out from the temple toward the east, emphasizing the theological significance of the eastward direction in Israel's sanctuary.
Complementary verse describing the symmetrical width of the west side (also 50 cubits), completing the picture of the courtyard's dimensions.
